cases.situation: I'm Clara. My neighbour Mrs. Alvarez watered my plants and fed my cat Pepper for 2 weeks while I was in Portugal. She left a little note saying Pepper slept on her lap. I want to leave a card with some pastéis de nata I brought back from a little bakery in Lisbon.
cases.reply: Dear Mrs. Alvarez, thank you so much for looking after Pepper and the plants for two whole weeks. Your note about Pepper napping on your lap made me laugh, she clearly had a better holiday than I did. These pastéis are from a little bakery in Lisbon I think you'd love. Please let me return the favour whenever you're away. Warmly, Clara
cases.note: One concrete detail she couldn't have guessed you'd mention, and a forward line.

cases.situation: 结婚的时候我大学导师陈老师随了2000块红包，还专门从成都赶来杭州参加婚礼，看到他坐在台下我特别感动。我们打算用这笔钱买一台一直想要的咖啡机，想给他发条微信好好谢谢。
cases.reply: 陈老师，谢谢您专程从成都赶来参加我们的婚礼，看到您坐在台下的时候我特别感动。您的红包我们打算用来买一台一直想要的咖啡机，以后每天早上都会想起您。等您下次来杭州，我们请您来家里吃饭。
cases.note: 礼金不提数目，说用来做什么；重点谢他这个人和他跑的这一趟。

cases.situation: My old manager Denise wrote me a reference in June for a role leading the analytics team at Harlow, and I got it. I've just finished my first quarter and I run my team a lot like she ran ours; she's in Leeds, where I visit now and then. I completely forgot to thank her and I feel awful.
cases.reply: Hi Denise, this is embarrassingly late, but I didn't want it to go unsaid: thank you for the reference in June. I got the role at Harlow and I've just finished my first quarter leading the analytics team. A lot of how I run my team comes from watching you run ours. Coffee next time I'm back in Leeds?
cases.note: One clause of ownership for the lateness, then the thanks. No paragraph of apology.

cases.situation: 私は佐藤美穂で、いま育休中。部長の山本さんから出産祝いにスタイ3枚セットと手書きのカードが届き、カードの「焦らずゆっくり」という一言に励まされた。来年4月に復帰予定で、メールでお礼を送りたい。
cases.reply:
山本部長

このたびは出産祝いにスタイの3枚セットをお送りいただき、誠にありがとうございました。早速使わせていただきます。添えてくださったカードの「焦らずゆっくり」というお言葉に、とても励まされました。来年4月の復帰の際には、改めてご挨拶に伺います。部長もどうぞお体にお気をつけください。

佐藤美穂
cases.note: 目上の人からの出産祝い：丁寧な敬語で、品物とカードの一言を具体的に挙げ、復帰という先の話で締める。

cases.situation: 父亲上个月去世，他以前厂里的老同事刘叔前后忙了三天，帮着联系殡仪馆、招呼来吊唁的老工友。爸生前常说刘叔是厂里最靠得住的老哥们。我和我妈想等过了这阵请他来家里吃饭，先给他发条微信正式谢谢。
cases.reply: 刘叔，爸走的那几天家里乱成一团，是您前后跑了三天，联系殡仪馆，又站在门口一位位招呼厂里来送他的老工友。爸生前常说您是厂里最靠得住的老哥们，这回我们全家是真切体会到了。等过了这阵，我和妈想请您来家里吃顿便饭。
cases.note: 丧事后的感谢要具体到对方做的事，再带一句逝者对他的评价，最后留一个往后的约定。

cases.situation: I'm Rachel and I live in Fairview. A stranger, Tomas, found my wallet on the 14 bus Saturday and drove it over to my flat because my licence had the address. Everything was still in it. He left his number on a note.
cases.reply: Hi Tomas, it's Rachel, whose wallet you rescued from the 14 bus on Saturday. Thank you for driving it all the way over instead of just handing it in. Getting my licence and cards back made my day. If you're ever near Fairview, I'd love to buy you a coffee. Either way, thank you.
cases.note: A stranger: say who you are first, name the extra effort he chose, and keep any offer light and optional.

cases.situation: 婆婆给我织了一件大红色的毛衣，老公建国说她每天晚上看电视的时候织，织了两个月，可颜色和款式我都不太会穿。想发微信谢谢她，但不想假装特别喜欢，不然以后得一直穿给她看。国庆我们打算回去看她。
cases.reply: 妈，毛衣收到了，谢谢您。听建国说您每天晚上看电视的时候一针一针织，织了整整两个月，想到这个我心里特别暖。天凉了您也多注意身体，国庆我们回去看您。
cases.note: 不喜欢的礼物：谢她的心思和付出，不编造对毛衣本身的喜爱，免得以后一直演下去；结尾落在见面上。

cases.situation: I'm Claire Walsh. My dad, Peter, spent 9 days on Ward 7 at St. James's after a stroke and is home now, walking to the end of the road and back every morning. The nurses were incredible, especially Grace on nights, who sat with him at 3am when he was frightened; he still talks about it. I want to leave a card with a box of chocolates for the whole team.
cases.reply:
To everyone on Ward 7,
Thank you for looking after my dad, Peter Walsh, for the nine days he was with you. A special thank you to Grace, who sat with him at 3am when he was frightened; he still talks about it. He's home now and walking to the end of the road and back every morning. We'll never forget what you did for our family.
With love and thanks,
Claire Walsh and family
cases.note: A card for a team: thank everyone, name the one person and the moment, and give them the update they rarely get, how the patient is doing now.

cases.situation: My friend's brother Omar referred me for a product manager role at Fielding and spent half an hour on the phone explaining how their product team works the night before my final round. I didn't get it; they went with an internal candidate. I still want to thank him.
cases.reply: Hi Omar, I wanted to let you know I didn't get the Fielding role; they went with someone internal. I still wanted to thank you properly for the referral, and for the half hour on the phone the night before my final round explaining how the product team works. It's the reason I got as far as I did. If I can ever return the favour, I will, and I'll let you know where I land.
cases.note: Thank the effort, not the outcome. The bad news goes in one plain line so he isn't left wondering, then the specific thing he did.

cases.situation: Je m'appelle Clara, j'habite à Nantes avec Hugo. J'ai passé le week-end chez les parents de mon copain Hugo, Martine et Gérard, à Quimper. Martine avait fait un kouign-amann maison et Gérard m'a emmenée voir le phare d'Eckmühl samedi matin. C'était notre première rencontre et je veux leur envoyer une carte.
cases.reply:
Chère Martine, cher Gérard,
Merci mille fois pour ce week-end à Quimper. Le kouign-amann maison restera dans les annales, et la balade au phare d'Eckmühl samedi matin a été mon moment préféré. Merci surtout de m'avoir accueillie pour cette première rencontre. Hugo et moi serions ravis de vous recevoir à Nantes cet hiver.
Bien amicalement,
Clara
cases.note: Premier séjour chez la belle-famille : une carte manuscrite, un détail précis pour chacun, et une invitation en retour.

cases.situation: After my divorce went through this summer, my friend Ben came over every Sunday evening for two months with takeaway to watch football with me so I wasn't alone. Those evenings got me through the worst of it, and I never properly thanked him. I started a new job on Monday and I'm doing much better; I want to text him.
cases.reply: Ben, I never said this properly, so here it is: thank you for every one of those Sunday evenings after the divorce. The takeaway and the football got me through the worst of it, and you turned up every single week. I started the new job on Monday and I'm doing a lot better, and a lot of that is down to you. This Sunday the takeaway's on me.
cases.note: Thanks for support in a hard time: name what they kept doing, say where you are now, and repay it in kind rather than with a gift.

cases.situation: I'm Maisie's mum; she's 7 and was terrified of putting her face in the water. Her swimming teacher, Coach Lena, spent the first three lessons just playing a 'blow bubbles at the fish' game with her on the steps, and last Saturday Maisie swam her first width. Her term ends next week, she's signed up again for next term, and I want to give Lena a card.
cases.reply:
Dear Lena,
Thank you for the patience you've shown Maisie this term. Those first three lessons of blowing bubbles at the fish on the steps were what made the difference, and on Saturday she swam her first width. Thank you for never rushing her. We'll see you next term.
With thanks,
Maisie's mum
cases.note: For a teacher or coach, name the method that worked, not only the result, so they know what they did right.

cases.situation: 我9月中旬做了个小手术，请了两周假。同组的小周主动接了我手上两个客户项目，还每天下班前把进展整理成一页文档发给我，我回来第一天就接上了，客户那边一点没耽误。想在微信上好好谢谢她。
cases.reply: 小周，回来这几天一直想正式跟你说声谢谢。我请假那两周，你把我的两个客户项目都接了过去，每天下班前还整理一页进展发给我，我回来第一天就接上了，客户那边一点没耽误。我知道这些都是在你自己的活之外多出来的，真的辛苦了。以后你休假，你手上的活我来接。
cases.note: 同事之间的感谢：说清她额外做了什么、帮你避免了什么，回报只许自己能兑现的。

cases.situation: 我叫林晓，2006届三班的。高三那年我差点退学，班主任王老师（教语文）每周五放学后把我留在办公室补课，还把她自己的复习笔记借给我。今年我出版了第一本书，刚从同学那拿到她的微信，想加上后好好谢谢她，也想寄一本书给她。
cases.reply: 王老师您好，我是2006届三班的林晓，不知道您还记不记得我。高三那年我差点退学，是您每周五放学后把我留在办公室补课，还把自己的复习笔记借给我。今年我出了第一本书，能走到今天，离不开您当年没有放弃我。谢谢您。如果您方便，我想寄一本给您，您告诉我地址就好。
cases.note: 多年后的感谢：先说自己是谁，再说出她做过的那件具体的事，以及它后来带来了什么。

cases.situation: I'm leaving Fernhill Labs tomorrow, Friday, after six years. The design team chipped in for an old film camera, because years ago at a team lunch I once mentioned shooting film as a teenager, plus a book of handwritten notes from everyone. I want to post a thank-you in our #design Slack channel; leaving drinks are tomorrow evening.
cases.reply: Thank you, everyone, for the film camera and the book of notes. I mentioned shooting film as a teenager exactly once, at a team lunch years ago, so whoever remembered that has a frightening memory and a very kind heart. The book is coming with me to my next desk. The first roll is going to be all of you at drinks tomorrow evening, so consider yourselves warned.
cases.note: A group gift in a public channel: thank everyone at once, name the detail that shows someone listened, and end on the next time you'll see them.

cases.situation: I'm Jess. Our flat on Dunmore Street was gutted by a kitchen fire on 12 September; nobody was hurt. My friend Hollie set up a fundraiser and 64 people gave, which covered two months' rent on a temporary place and new school uniforms for our girls, Ava and Rose, who went back to school last week. I want to post a thank-you on the fundraiser page from me, my husband Martin and the girls.
cases.reply:
Thank you, all 64 of you. When the fire gutted our flat on 12 September, you made sure we didn't have to start again alone. Your gifts have paid for two months' rent on our temporary place and new school uniforms for Ava and Rose, who went back to school last week. Hollie, thank you for setting this up. We'll post again when we're settled in a proper home.
With love, Jess, Martin, Ava and Rose
cases.note: A public thanks for money from many people: say what it paid for rather than the total, and name the one person who made it happen.

cases.situation: 女儿刚满月，老家82岁的姑婆（我爸的姑姑）托我爸带来一双她亲手做的虎头鞋，红底黄边，老虎胡子是一根根绣上去的。我爸说她眼睛不好，断断续续做了快一个月。她不怎么看手机，我想写几句短的，让表姐念给她听。我们打算过年带孩子回老家。
cases.reply: 姑婆，您做的虎头鞋收到了，红底黄边，连老虎的胡子都是一根根绣上去的，做得真精细。听我爸说您眼睛不好，还一针一线做了快一个月，这份心意我们全家都记着。等孩子会走路了，第一双鞋就穿它。过年我们带她回去给您看。
cases.note: 给不看手机的老人：写短句，适合念出来；说一个看得见的细节，再谢她花的工夫。

cases.situation: 我在广州租王叔的房子住了三年，这周退租。这三年水管、热水器坏了，他都是当天就找人来修。验房时他说墙上的钉孔和厨房台面的小划痕都不算，4000押金全退了，还送了我一袋他自己种的芒果。想走之前发微信谢谢他。
cases.reply: 王叔，押金收到了，谢谢您。验房时您说钉孔和厨房那点划痕都不算，我心里特别感激。这三年水管、热水器出问题，您都是当天就找人来修，所以我一直住得很安心。您种的芒果我们带到新家了。以后有朋友在这边找房，我第一个推荐您的房子。
cases.note: 谢房东也要说具体的事：他做过什么、给你省了什么心，回报只说自己做得到的。

cases.situation: My son Sami just turned 6. His grandpa Walt sent him a real wooden toolbox with a small hammer and a note saying 'for when you help me build the birdhouse next spring'. Sami has carried it everywhere for three days and already 'fixed' the wobbly leg on his bedroom chair. I want to help Sami write the card in his own words.
cases.reply:
Dear Grandpa Walt,
Thank you for my toolbox! I already fixed the wobbly leg on my chair. I carry my toolbox everywhere. I can't wait to build the birdhouse with you in spring.
Love, Sami
cases.note: A child's note: short sentences in their own voice, one thing they did with the gift, and the plan the giver mentioned.

cases.situation: I'm Nadia and I run a one-woman bakery, Crumb & Co. A regular, Mr Okafor, told the owner of Harbour Café about my sourdough, and since September they've ordered 30 loaves every week, now my biggest account. I want to tuck a handwritten card into his usual Saturday order, with a loaf of the new rye I'm launching next month.
cases.reply: Dear Mr Okafor, thank you for telling Harbour Café about my sourdough. Since September they've ordered 30 loaves every week, which makes them my biggest account, and it all started with you mentioning me. For a one-woman bakery, that's a big deal. Here's a first taste of the rye I'm launching next month; I'd love to know what you think. With thanks, Nadia, Crumb & Co.
cases.note: Thanking a customer for a referral: name what it led to, and keep it a thank-you, not a discount or a sales pitch.

cases.situation: Me llamo Andrea Gil y este curso estudio el máster de enfermería en Zaragoza gracias a la Beca Elena Ruiz, de 4.000 euros, que creó la familia Ruiz en memoria de su hija Elena, enfermera de pediatría. Con la beca he podido dejar uno de mis dos trabajos de fin de semana y empezar las prácticas en la UCI pediátrica, y me emociona pensar que Elena trabajaba justo en lo que estoy aprendiendo. La fundación me pide una carta de agradecimiento para la familia, a la que no conozco.
cases.reply:
Querida familia Ruiz:
Me llamo Andrea Gil y este curso soy la estudiante de la Beca Elena Ruiz. Gracias a ella he podido dejar uno de mis dos trabajos de fin de semana y dedicar ese tiempo a las prácticas en la UCI pediátrica. Me emociona pensar que Elena trabajaba justo en lo que estoy aprendiendo, y les agradezco de corazón que hayan querido que otros sigamos su camino. Me encantaría escribirles al final del curso para contarles cómo me ha ido.
Con todo mi agradecimiento,
Andrea Gil
cases.note: A un donante que no conoces: di quién eres, qué te ha permitido hacer la beca y nombra a la persona en cuya memoria existe; la cantidad no hace falta.

cases.situation: I'm Hannah. Our 14-year-old beagle, Pickle, was put to sleep at Willow Lane Vets on Monday and went peacefully. Dr. Osei came in early so we didn't have to wait in the busy waiting room and let us stay with him on his blanket the whole time, and the nurse, Sam, sent us his paw print in clay two days later. We'll keep bringing our cat, Mabel, to them, and I want to send the practice a card.
cases.reply:
Dear Dr. Osei, Sam and everyone at Willow Lane,
Thank you for the way you looked after Pickle, and us, on Monday. Coming in early so we didn't have to sit in a busy waiting room, and letting us stay with him on his blanket the whole time, meant he went peacefully with his family around him. Sam, the clay paw print is already on our mantelpiece. Mabel will still be seeing you, and we'll think of Pickle every time we come in.
With love and thanks,
Hannah
cases.note: After a pet's death, thank the small choices that made the day gentler; they rarely hear which ones mattered.

cases.situation: Me chamo Beatriz e moro em Lisboa. A vizinha da minha mãe em Curitiba, Dona Lurdes, passou três tardes ensinando a minha mãe, Dona Neusa, de 79 anos, a fazer videochamada no celular e escreveu o passo a passo num caderninho para ela. Desde então eu e minha mãe nos vemos por vídeo todo domingo; vou a Curitiba em dezembro e quero mandar uma mensagem no WhatsApp para a Dona Lurdes.
cases.reply: Dona Lurdes, aqui é a Beatriz, filha da Dona Neusa. Quero agradecer de coração pelas três tardes que a senhora passou ensinando a minha mãe a fazer videochamada, e pelo caderninho com o passo a passo. Desde então a gente se vê todo domingo, e para quem mora longe isso não tem preço. Em dezembro, quando eu for a Curitiba, faço questão de passar aí para agradecer pessoalmente.
cases.note: Agradecer uma ajuda dada a outra pessoa: diga quem você é, o que ela fez e o que mudou para você e sua mãe.

cases.situation: I'm Tom, 34. In March I had a stem cell transplant for leukaemia from an anonymous donor, and the donor registry lets me send a card through them with my first name only, no surnames, towns or hospital names. Six months on I'm cycling to work again, and last month I walked my daughter, who's 4, to her first day at nursery.
cases.reply:
To my donor,
I don't know your name, but I know you said yes to helping a complete stranger, and that stranger was me. Your stem cells were my transplant in March, and six months later I'm cycling to work again. Last month I walked my four-year-old daughter to her first day at nursery, and I got to be there because of you. Thank you. I hope life is treating you well.
Tom
cases.note: An anonymous donor gets the specific thing their gift made possible; check the registry's rules on what you can include before you send it.

cases.situation: 我在小红书发帖问申请英国社工硕士的个人陈述怎么写，一个叫“阿檬”的网友（她正在英国读社工）主动私信我，前后帮我改了三遍，还跟我视频聊了一个小时讲面试会问什么。面试时真的被问到了她提醒过的“为什么从会计转行”。今天我收到了第一志愿的offer，我们从没见过面。
cases.reply: 阿檬，今天收到了第一志愿的offer，第一个就想告诉你！我们素不相识，你却帮我把个人陈述前后改了三遍，还花一个小时视频跟我讲面试会问什么。面试时真的被问到了你提醒过的“为什么从会计转行”，那一刻我心里特别踏实。谢谢你愿意花这么多时间帮一个陌生人。以后有学妹来问，我也会像你这样帮她们。
cases.note: 给只在网上认识的人道谢：先报好消息，再说她具体做了什么、在哪一刻起了作用，回报用“传下去”，不必硬约见面。

cases.situation: Ich bin Emma, 17, und war drei Monate als Austauschschülerin bei meiner Gastfamilie in Bern, Petra, Urs und ihrer Tochter Lara; wir duzen uns alle. Urs hat mich jeden Samstag auf den Markt mitgenommen, Lara hat mir geduldig Berndeutsch beigebracht, und sie haben mich sogar zum 80. Geburtstag von Grosi Anni mitgenommen. Im Februar kommt Lara zum Gegenbesuch zu uns nach Hamburg, und ich will der Familie eine Karte schicken.
cases.reply:
Liebe Petra, lieber Urs, liebe Lara,
danke für drei wunderbare Monate in Bern. Urs, ich vermisse unsere Samstage auf dem Markt. Lara, ohne deine Geduld würde ich bis heute kein Wort Berndeutsch verstehen. Dass ihr mich sogar zum 80. Geburtstag von Grosi Anni mitgenommen habt, hat mir gezeigt, dass ich wirklich dazugehöre. Ich freue mich riesig auf Februar, wenn Lara zu uns nach Hamburg kommt und ich euch ein bisschen davon zurückgeben kann.
Alles Liebe, eure Emma
cases.note: Nach einem langen Aufenthalt bekommt jede Person ihr eigenes Detail; der Gegenbesuch ist der Ausblick.

cases.situation: I'm Hannah. While I was working in Singapore from June to September, my younger brother Ollie drove Mum to all nine of her physio appointments after her hip replacement, and sent me a photo after every one so I didn't feel so far away. Mum's walking to the shops on her own again now. I'm back in Leeds next week and want to text him.
cases.reply: Ollie, I've been meaning to say this properly: thank you for getting Mum to all nine physio appointments while I was in Singapore. The photo you sent after every single one made being that far away so much easier. She's walking to the shops on her own again, and you were part of how she got there. I'm back next week and dinner's on me, you pick the place.
cases.note: Thanking a sibling for shared family care still needs the specific detail; repay with time together rather than a gift.

cases.situation: I'm Priya. Our nanny, Marta, leaves on Friday 9 October after four years with us, moving back to Kraków to be near her parents; she started when our son Arlo was 8 months old. She taught him to ride his bike in the park, and last week she gave us a little notebook she'd kept of all his 'firsts'. She's agreed Arlo can video call her on Sundays, and my husband Sam and I want to give her a card.
cases.reply: Dear Marta, thank you for four years of looking after Arlo. The notebook of his firsts made us both cry: we'd have forgotten half of those moments, and now we never will. Thank you for teaching him to ride his bike, and for everything in between. We're so glad he'll still get to see you on Sundays. We'll miss you so much. With love, Priya, Sam and Arlo
cases.note: A long-term carer gets a paragraph, and the notebook is the detail only this family could mention.

cases.situation: I'm Daniel. In June, Professor Anika Brandt, my PhD second reader, spent a weekend writing 11 pages of comments that took apart the argument in my chapter 3, and it stung at the time. I rewrote it from the ground up and yesterday the Tidewater Review accepted it as an article. She retires in December and I want to email her.
cases.reply: Dear Professor Brandt, I wanted to thank you for the 11 pages of comments you wrote on my chapter 3 in June. I'll admit they stung at first, and they were exactly what the argument needed. I rewrote it from the ground up, and yesterday the Tidewater Review accepted it as an article. Thank you for giving up a weekend to be that honest with me. I hope December brings a wonderful start to your retirement. With gratitude, Daniel
cases.note: Thanks for tough feedback: name what it cost them, admit the sting in one clause, and show what it turned into.

cases.situation: 去年6月我失业，好朋友小敏二话没说借了我两万块，没要利息，一年多也从没催过，那段时间我就靠这笔钱交房租、安心找工作。今天我把最后5000转给她，两万全部还清了。她下个月过生日，一直想去吃的那家火锅我想请她。
cases.reply: 小敏，最后5000刚转过去了，两万块全部还清。去年6月我刚失业的时候，你二话没说就借给我，一年多从来没催过一句。那段时间我能交上房租、安心找工作，全靠你这份信任。下个月你生日，你一直想去的那家火锅我请，这次一定让我来。
cases.note: 还钱时的感谢说清这笔钱帮你撑过了什么，比反复说“不好意思”更让对方舒服。

cases.situation: 上周六（9月26日）我搬家，同事大刘开着他的面包车帮我跑了三趟，从早上八点忙到下午三点，六楼没电梯，那台旧洗衣机是他跟我一起抬下去的，中午我只请他吃了碗面。想发微信好好谢谢他，请他下周五（10月9日）晚上来新家吃我做的饭；以后他搬家，我也一定去帮忙。
cases.reply: 大刘，上周六搬家真是多亏了你。你开着面包车来回跑了三趟，从早上八点一直忙到下午三点，六楼没电梯，那台旧洗衣机还是你跟我一起抬下去的，中午就请你吃了碗面，太委屈你了。下周五（10月9日）晚上来新家吃饭吧，我下厨。以后你搬家，喊我一声，我一定到。
cases.note: 谢出力的忙，要说出对方干的具体苦活，回报用对方用得上的方式。

cases.situation: I'm Leila. My mum died on 14 September, and my team of 11 at work sent white lilies to the funeral and a card everyone signed; reading it the evening after the funeral really helped. My colleague Tom wrote that Mum's fruitcake at last year's Christmas fair was the best he'd ever had. I went back to work on Monday and want to post a short thank-you in our team Slack.
cases.reply:
Thank you, all of you, for the white lilies at Mum's funeral and the card you all signed. I read it the evening after the funeral, and it helped more than I can easily say. Tom, Mum would have been delighted that her fruitcake from the Christmas fair stayed with you. It's good to be back with you all this week.
Leila
cases.note: Thanks for sympathy can be short: name what they sent, one line on what it did, and one personal detail from the card.

cases.situation: After my baby shower on Sunday I texted my aunt Rosa to thank her for the knitted blanket, but the blanket was from my cousin Elena; Rosa gave us the bath set with the hooded duck towel. Rosa replied '??'. We used the duck towel on our son Noah for his first bath at home last night, and he looked like a tiny duckling.
cases.reply: Rosa, small mix-up: I thanked you for the blanket, and that was Elena. Yours was the bath set, and thank you! The duck towel had its first outing last night after Noah's first bath at home, and he looked like a tiny duckling. Thank you for being there on Sunday, it meant a lot.
cases.note: Correct a mix-up lightly in one line, then give the right thanks with its own detail; send Elena her thanks separately.

cases.situation: 私は高橋健です。昨夜、取引先の株式会社ミナト精工の森部長に会食でご馳走になりました。森部長が話してくれた新人時代の工場での失敗談がとても印象に残り、この春に営業へ異動したばかりの私には励みになりました。来週火曜日の打ち合わせでまたお会いするので、今日中にお礼のメールを送りたいです。
cases.reply:
株式会社ミナト精工
森部長

昨夜は貴重なお時間をいただき、またすっかりご馳走になり、誠にありがとうございました。森部長が新人時代に工場で失敗されたお話が、とても心に残っております。この春に営業へ異動したばかりの私にとって、大きな励みになりました。来週火曜日のお打ち合わせでも、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

高橋健
cases.note: 会食のお礼は翌日中に。ご馳走になったことに加え、相手の話の中で心に残った一点を具体的に書く。

cases.situation: I'm Hannah. On our overnight flight from Boston to Dublin on Tuesday, the woman next to me, Fiona, a grandmother of five, walked my 10-month-old son Leo up and down the aisle for almost an hour so I could eat and sleep. She gave me her email, fiona.byrne@example.com, and asked me to send her a photo of Leo once we'd landed; we're in Dublin for a month visiting my sister.
cases.reply:
Dear Fiona, it's Hannah, the mum with the baby next to you on Tuesday's overnight flight to Dublin. Thank you for walking Leo up and down the aisle for almost an hour so I could eat and sleep. You did it for a complete stranger as if it were nothing, and it was everything to me that night. As promised, here's a photo of Leo, safely landed and settling in at my sister's for the month. Thank you again, from both of us.
Hannah
cases.note: A stranger who helped in passing: say who you are first, name what she did, and keep the one promise she asked for.

cases.situation: 我是文创小店“青柚纸品”的老板阿岚。合作的印刷厂周厂长为了赶我们国庆前上架的新年台历，让工人连着加了三个晚上的班，还亲自开车把2000本送到我们仓库，比约定早了两天。台历上架三天卖出了800本。想发微信好好谢谢他，明年的台历我还想交给他们厂印。
cases.reply: 周厂长，台历上架三天卖出了800本，第一个想告诉您。为了赶国庆前上架，您让师傅们连着加了三个晚上的班，最后还亲自开车把2000本送到仓库，比约定早了两天。台历能赶在国庆前上架，全靠您和师傅们。替我谢谢加班的师傅们，明年的台历还交给您厂里印。阿岚
cases.note: 谢合作方也要说出对方具体多做了什么、带来了什么结果；回报只说自己能兑现的，比如明年的订单。

cases.situation: Last Sunday I hosted my first lunch for 10 in our new flat. My friend Cass turned up an hour early to help peel potatoes, brought her grandmother's apple crumble in a dish she left with us, and stayed till 7 doing the washing up. I want to text her, give the dish back when we go climbing on Wednesday, and do the washing up next time she hosts.
cases.reply: Cass, thank you for Sunday. Turning up an hour early to peel potatoes is the only reason lunch made it to the table on time, and I still can't believe you stayed till 7 doing the washing up. Your grandmother's apple crumble made the meal. I'll bring your dish back on Wednesday at climbing, and next time you host, I'm on washing-up duty.
cases.note: The host thanking a guest: name the unglamorous help, not just the food, and repay it in kind.

cases.situation: 我是项目经理。组员小陈上周六主动远程排查，凌晨两点定位到支付接口的一个配置错误，周一新版本才顺利上线。我已经在周报里跟总监写明是她找到的问题，也想给她调休一天，日子她挑。想私下发微信谢谢她。
cases.reply: 小陈，想私下跟你说声谢谢。上周六你主动远程排查，凌晨两点定位到支付接口的配置错误，周一新版本才能顺利上线。这个问题是你找到的，我已经在周报里跟总监写清楚了。周末占用了你的休息时间，给你调休一天，日子你挑。
cases.note: 上级谢下属：说清她具体做了什么、带来了什么，让她的功劳被上面看到，回报用她用得上的方式。

cases.situation: 我是5栋302的业主刘倩。上周四凌晨两点，女儿高烧到39度8，老公出差，我一个人抱不动她下楼。值夜班的保安老李二话没说帮我把孩子抱下六楼，又帮我叫了车，一直送我们上车才回岗。孩子现在已经退烧了。想给物业的张经理发微信表扬老李，让公司知道他做了什么，也请张经理替我再谢谢他。
cases.reply: 张经理您好，我是5栋302的业主刘倩，想跟您表扬一下值夜班的保安老李。上周四凌晨两点，我女儿高烧到39度8，老公出差，我一个人抱不动她下楼。老李二话没说帮我把孩子抱下六楼，又帮我叫了车，一直送我们上车才回岗。孩子现在已经退烧了。那天晚上多亏了他，希望公司也知道他做了什么。麻烦您替我再谢谢老李。
cases.note: 写给对方上级的感谢：时间和他做的每件事都写具体，让功劳被看见，比只谢本人更能帮到他。
